targetText: Let us assume that a capital of the same organic composition, that is, the same proportion between employed living labour-power and constant capital set in motion, is compelled to pay �150 instead of �100 for the same labour-power which sets in motion the constant capital of 400.
explanation: The organic composition of capital ($c/v$) reflects the ratio of dead labor (machinery and materials) to living labor-power employed in production.

targetText: But to the industrialists, merchants and bankers, and to the vulgar economists, this appears quite different.
explanation: Commercial or merchant capital doesn’t create new surplus value directly, but collects a share of total social profit by speeding up the circulation and sale of goods.
